timeline.summary: The Edemi Islands rebel and the emperor orders Overdark to quell the uprising; Overdark hopes Tetsuo will die in the conflict.
timeline.quote: The emperor orders his imperial assassin Ramses Overdark to quell the uprising.

timeline.quote: Wasitora and Tetsuo defeat the wurm.

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Overdark sends Lady Orca to attack Kusho in Umezawa's crest and orders Xira Arien to lure Tetsuo to the Edemis.
timeline.quote: orders the assassin Xira Arien to lure Tetsuo to the Edemis.

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo rewards Wasitora with the position of champion's deputy and she accepts.
timeline.quote: Wasitora accepts.

timeline.summary: Kei has a vision of Lady Orca murdering Kusho; Tetsuo realizes it is a trap but travels to Kusho with Tor and Ayesha.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo realizes it is a trap of Lord Overdark's creation but has to journey to Kusho to protect his honor

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo's group defeats Kusho's defenders and discovers Arien was never there and Orca has left for Argenti.
timeline.quote: The defenders are defeated, and Tetsuo discovers Arien was never on Kusho

timeline.summary: On Argenti the group defeats Lord Magnus, who leads them to Lady Caleria; Caleria has all the imperials arrested while Xira flees.
timeline.quote: Caleria reveals she isn't that gullible, however, and has all the imperials arrested.

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Overdark summons Lady Orca again; she attacks Caleria's castle and is defeated by Tetsuo, who is left drained.
timeline.quote: The giantess attacks Lady Caleria's castle but is defeated by Tetsuo.

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: Then Overdark activates the artifact Xira hid for him- a Serpent Generator .

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Caleria is defeated in the duel and lets the group leave; Tetsuo and Ayesha kill the insect inside Kei, halting his mutation.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo and Ayesha engage the insect inside Kei on the Meditation plane and kill it.

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ayesha and Tetsuo stop Xira's spawn from growing, but Kei keeps the insectoid mutations.

timeline.summary: Bolas punishes Tetsuo, who must accompany the kentsu; Ayesha, Kei and Tor are put under kentsu control.
timeline.quote: Ayesha, Kei, and Tetsuo's second, Tor Wauki , were also put under kentsu control.

timeline.summary: Ayesha and Tor reunite with Tetsuo and persuade him to become imperial champion again.
timeline.quote: they convinced him to take up the role of imperial champion once more

timeline.summary: Tetsuo saves Hatoki from Xira Arien, tracks her down and kills her.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo tracks her down, kills her, and blasts her body into a crater of molten glass.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo levels the Kentsu at the shrine with a meteor storm and kills Hage.
timeline.quote: Only the black-mana-infused Jorgan Hage survives but is killed by Tetsuo's sword.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo kills Overdark in the Imperial Shrine after Bolas's spell is deflected onto him.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo and Kei go to Sekana, where the Nekoru Wasitora agrees to let the Kentsu pass if they avoid her kittens.
timeline.quote: She will if the soldiers stay well away from her newborn kittens.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elsdragon, Tetsuo and Overdark meet on the Meditation Plane and invoke the emperor, who destroys the Greater Realm of Preservation just by blinking.
timeline.quote: Elsdragon and Tetsuo meet Overdark on the Meditation Plane and the three of them invoke the emperor, who destroys the Realm just by blinking.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo destroys Orca's lair, killing her.
timeline.quote: which he destroys, killing Orca.

timeline.quote: former champion Tetsuo Umezawa killed Overdark and exiled Bolas

timeline.quote: resulting in his imprisonment

citation.text: "Madara-Edemi War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Umezawa defeats Lady Orca, escapes imprisonment and stabilizes Kei in the Meditation Plane.

citation.text: "Madara-Edemi War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Madara-Edemi War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Umezawa kills Xira Arien and Jorgan Hage, storms the Imperial Shrine and decapitates Overdark, absorbing his power.
timeline.quote: Umezawa decapitated the assassin and absorbed his magical power

citation.text: "Madara-Edemi War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Umezawa destroys the shrine and defeats the Emperor, revealed as Nicol Bolas, in the Meditation Plane.
